old_caption:

old_caption:

title: The stars aligned
old_caption: Seven stars, one simple instruction, and they still lined up sideways. Violet slept through half of it. Who's the violet in your friend group?

title: Tonight's moon
old_caption: The moon left sticky notes. One of them stopped a very honest text about chewing just in time. What would your moon's note say tonight?

title: You were born a card
old_caption: Your sign card, polished like a rare collectible. Mint condition, never been swiped. Taurus is very proud of the foil. What is your big three?
